criteria.name: Exhaustiveness
criteria.rationale: Captures the four primary events present in the text but fails to account for the complete expected narrative arc.

criteria.name: Source grounding
criteria.rationale: Every included phase is completely supported by the grounding passages with no invented details.

criteria.name: Ordering & non-overlap
criteria.rationale: The phases appear in correct chronological narrative order and are mutually distinct.

criteria.name: Abstraction
criteria.rationale: Directly violates the abstraction constraint by lifting near-verbatim wording from the grounding passages.

criteria.name: Tier fit
criteria.rationale: Only provides four broad phases rather than the expected dozen distinct macro-phases for a full arc.

criteria.name: Honest abstention
criteria.rationale: Completely fails to use the [NOT DERIVABLE FROM GROUNDING] tag for structurally expected missing phases like the return and restoration.

instructions: Rewrite all phase descriptions using purely abstract structural vocabulary rather than copying near-verbatim phrases from the source text.
Expand the taxonomy to reflect a full macro-tier arc of roughly a dozen phases, rather than just a handful.
Explicitly include structurally expected but missing phases (such as the Return and Restoration) and label them with the [NOT DERIVABLE FROM GROUNDING] tag.
